text:
maya: Quick heads-up — SAST job in CI is failing on PR #1452 after the infra RBAC tidy yesterday. Error looks like a KMS decrypt issue. Anyone who touched IAM yesterday?

alex: I modified a few service-account bindings in infra cleanup. Which service account is erroring?

maya: CI log snippet:```
ERROR: failed to decrypt secret: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/sast-key: permission denied for cryptoKeyVersions/1: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypt missing
Stack: /workspace/scan/run-sast.sh:42
```

ci-bot: build 4821 failed: sast-scan (exit 1) — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4821 :x:

toni: Likely the redwood-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com lost roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on that key. Quick mitigation: re-add the IAM binding, re-run the job. Example command:```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-key \
  --location=global --keyring=ci-keys \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
After that, trigger the pipeline: `ci rerun --job sast-scan`. Also create a short incident note so audit logs capture the rollback.

sam: Also +1 to adding an automated check to the RBAC changeplaybook: pre-merge test that tries to decrypt a small test blob with the service account (fails fast). We keep hitting manual rollbacks.

security-bot: Created incident INC-2026 and added eng-oncall and infra-team. Audit trail linked: https://audit.redwood.example/INC-2026 :eyes:

alex: I'm on it — reapplying binding now, will re-run once done.

maya: thanks. After CI passes let's update the RBAC PR template to include a checkbox for "verify scanner/service-account access to KMS keys and registries" and add a one-liner to the security-runbook about scanning-impacting RBAC changes.

toni: Agreed. I'll draft the checklist addition and a 3-step triage playbook snippet for the runbook: 1) check build error (KMS vs network vs scanner version), 2) verify IAM binding & reapply if accidental, 3) create incident and attach audit log. Keep it short so oncall can follow quickly.

maya: Sweet. tagging @alex when build is green. :thumbsup:
